Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS: Palo Alto's FY2024 10-K cover (325.6 million shares, August 19, 2024) predates its two-for-one stock split of December 12, 2024, while CalPERS's December 31, 2024 holding is post-split, so the denominator is the cover page of the next post-split filing, the 10-Q for the quarter ended January 31, 2025 (rounded to 662.1 million).
